crossRefs.note: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived…
When the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel, lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
translations.bsb: So the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, and temple servants, along with some of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. And by the seventh month the Israelites had settled in their towns.
translations.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
translations.asv: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities. And when the seventh month was come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
